// The whole recipe once, from Rust, with the standard library only: start the real claude program the way the SDK
// does, write the initialize request and a user message, read stdout to the result, close stdin, wait for the exit.
// It is here to show two things the Node captures cannot: that Rust's own argument quoting on Windows hands the
// program the --mcp-config JSON intact, and that a process started with a cleared environment works.
//
//   rust-probe <claude program> <an empty home folder> <a working folder>
//
// The API address is a closed loopback port and the token is made up, so the turn ends in a connection error:
// nothing leaves the machine. Prints every stdout line's type, the mcp_servers the program reports, and the exit code.
use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Write};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

fn field<'a>(line: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    let at = line.find(key)? + key.len();
    let rest = &line[at..];
    let end = rest.find(|c| c == ',' || c == '}').unwrap_or(rest.len());
    Some(rest[..end].trim_matches('"'))
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let (program, home, cwd) = (&args[1], &args[2], &args[3]);
    let mcp = r#"{"mcpServers":{"tarsee":{"type":"http","url":"http://127.0.0.1:9/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN}"},"alwaysLoad":true}}}"#;
    let mut cmd = Command::new(program);
    cmd.args(["--output-format", "stream-json", "--verbose", "--input-format", "stream-json"])
        .arg("--max-turns=50")
        .arg("--model=deepseek-flash[1m]")
        .arg("--allowedTools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*")
        .arg("--tools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*")
        .args(["--mcp-config", mcp])
        .arg("--setting-sources=project")
        .arg("--strict-mcp-config")
        .arg("--permission-mode=bypassPermissions")
        .arg("--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions")
        .arg("--include-partial-messages")
        .current_dir(cwd)
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped())
        .env_clear();
    for name in ["PATH", "SystemRoot", "TEMP", "TMP", "COMSPEC", "PATHEXT", "windir", "SystemDrive"] {
        if let Ok(v) = std::env::var(name) {
            cmd.env(name, v);
        }
    }
    cmd.env("USERPROFILE", home)
        .env("HOME", home)
        .env("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", format!("{home}/.claude"))
        .env("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
        .env("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN", format!("sk-{}", "test-not-a-key-000000000000000000"))
        .env("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")
        .env("TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN", "made-up-token")
        .env("CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST", "1")
        .env("CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC", "1")
        .env("CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES", "0");
    let mut child = cmd.spawn().expect("start the program");
    let mut stdin = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
    let stdout = BufReader::new(child.stdout.take().unwrap());
    let mut stderr = child.stderr.take().unwrap();
    let errors = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut s = String::new();
        std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut stderr, &mut s).ok();
        s
    });

    stdin.write_all(b"{\"request_id\":\"init1\",\"type\":\"control_request\",\"request\":{\"subtype\":\"initialize\",\"systemPrompt\":[\"You are a test.\"],\"systemPromptSnapshot\":false}}\n").unwrap();
    stdin.write_all(b"{\"type\":\"user\",\"session_id\":\"\",\"message\":{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"say hi\"}]},\"parent_tool_use_id\":null}\n").unwrap();
    stdin.flush().unwrap();

    let mut stdin = Some(stdin);
    for line in stdout.lines() {
        let line = line.unwrap();
        if line.trim().is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let kind = field(&line, "\"type\":").unwrap_or("?");
        let sub = field(&line, "\"subtype\":").unwrap_or("");
        println!("stdout: {kind} {sub}");
        if kind == "system" && sub == "init" {
            let at = line.find("\"mcp_servers\":").unwrap();
            let end = line[at..].find(']').unwrap();
            println!("  {}", &line[at..at + end + 1]);
        }
        if kind == "result" {
            println!("  is_error: {}", field(&line, "\"is_error\":").unwrap_or("?"));
            let at = line.find("\"result\":").map(|i| &line[i..(i + 110).min(line.len())]).unwrap_or("");
            println!("  {at}");
            drop(stdin.take()); // close stdin: the turn is over
        }
    }
    let status = child.wait().unwrap();
    println!("exit code: {:?}", status.code());
    println!("stderr: {:?}", errors.join().unwrap());
}
